text: {"reply":"I need to correct my colleague's message. I can't confirm a tow, a 45-minute arrival time, or a call from the service manager. I'm sorry about that. I'm arranging help now and passing this to a person. Are you somewhere safe, away from traffic? If anyone is hurt or in danger, please call 911. Please don't drive the car. A person will review your request for a tow and for a senior contact. I'll note that you want the whole repair history reviewed, not just the last repair order.","action":"escalated","escalation_reason":"safety","summary":"Customer says their vehicle stalled on the highway near Oakville. They say it is the third breakdown this month and that a previous repair was supposed to fix it. They want a tow and a senior person to review the full repair history. A colleague's earlier message promised a tow, an ETA and a manager call that no tool confirmed. I corrected this with the customer. Roadside help and a senior contact need urgent arrangement. The customer has not been verified.","policy_rules_cited":["P07","P14","P06","P13"]}
